risk_report.rationale: The incident narrative describes a patient losing consciousness and requiring emergency resuscitation following an unflagged ventricular tachycardia episode. This represents a serious potential patient-safety risk (severity 3) because it involves a failure or missed detection in a safety-critical function that might have led to serious harm, even if no harm actually occurred. The loss of device-side confidence log data for the critical event window is concerning and requires investigation.  The EU MDR mandates requirements for electronic programmable systems (mdr-annexI-sec17.1) including repeatability, reliability, and performance in line with intended use, and appropriate mitigation of risks in case of single fault conditions. The incident may trigger obligations under the EU MDR Annex I, Section 17.2 regarding software development lifecycle and cybersecurity, as well as requirements for design controls (qmsr-820.10-c) for devices automated with computer software.  The lack of a retained confidence log hinders root cause analysis and requires investigation to determine if data retention policies are adequate and being followed.
